kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننعكس (form VII)
# نَنْعَكِسُ (nanʕakisu) /nan.ʕa.ki.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْعَكَسَ (inʕakasa)
# نَنْعَكِسَ (nanʕakisa) /nan.ʕa.ki.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَكَسَ (inʕakasa)
# نَنْعَكِسْ (nanʕakis) /nan.ʕa.kis/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْعَكَسَ (inʕakasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
